risks.proof: A video showing the blender running with a load (e.g., water) to verify motor strength and sound.

risks.risk: The item is likely a generic blender with a counterfeit Kenwood sticker.
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's rating plate on the bottom of the base to see the actual brand and wattage.

risks.risk: The jar may have cracks or the blade assembly may leak.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the jar's interior blades and the bottom seal of the jar.

proof_requests: Video of the blender operating at different speeds.
Photo of the technical specification plate on the bottom of the base.

response.reason: The item is a high-power commercial blender. Although the branding appears to be a counterfeit sticker on a generic unit, it can be priced as a generic model in its worst-case (non-functional) state.
